requirements.name: go-application
requirements.text: Implement in Go 1.22 or newer using only the standard library. The application root is a Go module, and its executable is the main package at `./cmd/csvstat`. Tests run under `go test`.

requirements.name: command-options
requirements.text:
csvstat [--column <name>] <file>
csvstat --freq <name> [--top <n>] <file>

requirements.name: csv-reading
requirements.text: The file is UTF-8 CSV as RFC 4180 defines it, read with Go's `encoding/csv`. The first record is the header.

requirements.name: trim-fields
requirements.text: Every header name and every value is trimmed of leading and trailing spaces before any other rule applies.

requirements.name: validate-input
requirements.text: The file is **rejected** when it is empty, when a header name is empty or repeated, or when any record has a different number of fields from the header.

requirements.name: normalize-nulls
requirements.text: **Null.** A value is null when it is empty, or when it equals `NA`, `N/A`, or `NULL` ignoring case. All other values are non-null.

requirements.name: infer-column-types
requirements.text: A column's type is the first of these that every non-null value satisfies:

requirements.name: profile-columns
requirements.text:
For every column it infers a type and reports
row, null, and distinct counts, the minimum and maximum, and for numeric columns the sum, mean, and
median.

requirements.name: frequency-reports
requirements.text: It also lists the most frequent values of one column.

requirements.name: failure-diagnostics
requirements.text: A failing command writes nothing to standard output and one diagnostic line to standard error naming the file and, for a rejected record, its line number.

requirements.name: exit-codes
requirements.text:
| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `0` | Success. |
| `1` | Operational failure: the file cannot be opened or read. |
| `2` | Usage error: missing or extra file, unknown option, missing option value, `--top` not a positive integer, `--top` without `--freq`, `--column` with `--freq`. |
| `3` | Rejected: empty file, empty or repeated header name, ragged record, or a column name that is not in the header. |

requirements.name: test-gate
requirements.text:
The completed application provides a POSIX-compatible `bin/test.sh` that runs `go vet ./...` and
`go test ./...` from the application root and exits zero only when both pass.

requirements.name: conformance-suite
requirements.text: The harness runs `go build -o <temporary path> ./cmd/csvstat` and then runs 22 checks.
